description.zh: 长城是中国最具代表性的历史建筑，绵延超过21,000公里。建于多个朝代，主要段落修建于明代。慕田峪和司马台等段落保存完好，可俯瞰壮观的山地景色。
description.en: The Great Wall stretches over 21,000 km and is China's most iconic monument. Built across dynasties, the best-preserved Ming-era sections at Mutianyu and Simatai offer stunning mountain panoramas.

description.zh: 故宫是世界上保存最完整的古代皇宫建筑群，占地72万平方米，拥有近万间房屋。自1420年起作为明清两代皇宫使用长达近600年，现为故宫博物院。
description.en: The Forbidden City is the world's largest and best-preserved imperial palace complex, covering 72 ha with nearly 10,000 rooms. It served as the Ming and Qing imperial palace for nearly 600 years from 1420.
